title: Klammerdiagramm
desc: Leitan's constituency (E. Leitan samāsa-conspectus, MG vote D5, 16-07-2026): the left block {uddāma-ajñāna-rūpa} — "whose form is boundless ignorance" (uddāma-ajñāna = boundless ignorance, + rūpa) — joins the right-branching prabalatama-tamaḥ-stoma-soma-svabhāvā tail at the outermost node R; the I/II часть ‖-mark falls before svabhāvā (the plate's fell at tamaḥ), a reading-aid annotation independent of the binary nesting.
